items.stem: A topic-cluster SEO model organises content around:

options.text: A pillar page linked to related cluster content on subtopics
options.rationale: Correct: a pillar page covers a broad topic and links to cluster pages on specific subtopics, strengthening topical authority.

options.text: A single keyword repeated across unrelated pages
options.rationale: Keyword stuffing across unrelated pages is not the topic-cluster model.

options.text: Random blog posts with no internal links
options.rationale: Clusters depend on deliberate internal linking to a pillar.
Topic clusters are an organic/SEO structure, not paid ads.

items.stem: Which TWO are effective ways to convert website visitors into leads?

options.text: A clear call-to-action leading to a landing page with a form
options.rationale: Correct: CTAs and landing-page forms capture visitor information in exchange for an offer.

options.text: A gated content offer that collects contact details
options.rationale: Correct: gating valuable content behind a form is a standard lead-capture tactic.

options.text: Hiding all contact options from visitors
options.rationale: Hiding conversion paths reduces, not increases, leads.

options.text: Removing every form from the site
options.rationale: Without forms there is no lead capture.

options.text: Blocking search engines from the site
options.rationale: Blocking search engines reduces traffic and conversions.

items.explanation: Correct: CTAs and landing-page forms capture visitor information in exchange for an offer.
